decisive_spans.text: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion of mostly fat density with internal areas of soft-tissue density in the hepatorenal space measuring 11.2 × 9.7 × 14.4 cm
the right adrenal gland was not visualized separately. MRI confirmed a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland

response.rationale: Myelolipoma is strongly supported by the imaging findings of a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion with mostly fat density and internal soft-tissue density, located in the adrenal gland region, and the adrenal gland not being separately visualized. Liposarcoma is a reasonable alternative but lacks the specific adrenal gland localization and the explicit mention of 'mostly fat density' as prominently as myelolipoma. The other candidates are contradicted or less well-supported.
